Department of Education.title: Education Stabilization Fund FY2024 gross outlays by program and ESSER prime-recipient state
Department of Education.basis: Exact FY2024 period-12 DATA Act File C gross outlays reconcile to the $55.51615649037B federal-account control. ESSER is expanded to all 52 state and territory prime-recipient totals; the eight other ESF programs remain separate. These are federal gross outlays attributed to prime awards, not recipient-certified expenditures or Treasury net outlays.
